env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^2 3 2 1 4$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constbound

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func view() const []byte {
	return []byte("abcdef")[:4]
}

type limits struct{ hi int }

func (l limits) top() int {
	return l.hi
}

func main() {
	v := view()
	n := func(i int) int { return i }
	ix := []int{1, 3}
	l := limits{hi: 4}
	fmt.Println(len(v[:n(2)]), len(v[:ix[1]]), len(v[1:n(3)]), len(v[:(n(1))]), len(v[:l.top()]))
}
